name: Banswara

queries.query: Banswara Rajasthan official cadastral parcel map land records GIS BhuNaksha Rajdharaa
queries.result: First-party results identified Rajasthan BhuNaksha, Rajdharaa, and the Rajdharaa Urban GIS portal. The Urban GIS page exposes district/tehsil/village/khasra workflows and states that khasra and village boundaries are provided by Rajasthan's Settlement Department. No Banswara parcel feature response was obtained.

queries.query: बांसवाड़ा राजस्थान आधिकारिक भू नक्शा खसरा नक्शा भूमि अभिलेख GIS
queries.result: आधिकारिक परिणामों में राजस्थान भू-नक्शा, राजधरा अर्बन GIS और अपना खाता मिले। परिणामों ने राजस्थान के सरकारी खसरा/गांव सीमा मानचित्र कार्यप्रवाह को समर्थन दिया, लेकिन बांसवाड़ा का अनाम पार्सल ज्यामिति उत्तर नहीं मिला।

registryEvidence.custodian: Rajasthan Revenue Department / Settlement Department, with NIC BhuNaksha and Rajdharaa public GIS services
registryEvidence.scopeNote: This evidences a first-party Rajasthan cadastral/map custodian and public map workflows relevant to Banswara; it does not prove complete Banswara citywide parcel coverage or an open download API.

parcelDiscovery.source: NIC BhuNaksha Rajasthan; Rajdharaa Urban GIS
parcelDiscovery.note: No parcel feature, stable native identifier, schema response, CRS, or geometry was retained because the reachable UI/configuration did not yield a bounded anonymous feature response.

uncertainty: GET https://www.bhunaksha.rajasthan.gov.in/ and GET https://www.bhunaksha.rajasthan.gov.in/georef_gmaps.html timed out after 20 seconds from this environment with normal TLS verification; no certificate exception was used.

GET https://rajdharaa.rajasthan.gov.in/citizenudh/index returned HTTP 200 and its current JavaScript/configuration was inspected. Config.js identifies the public ArcGIS settlement/khasra layer as https://gisprod.rajasthan.gov.in/geocode/rest/services/JDA/Settlement_JDA/MapServer/0 and map.js constructs it as a FeatureLayer with outFields '*'; this is configuration evidence, not a returned parcel schema.
Anonymous metadata and bounded query attempts to the configured ArcGIS layer (f=pjson and where=1=0 with returnGeometry=true) timed out after 20 seconds; no response was retained.
GET https://apnakhata.rajasthan.gov.in/LRCLogin.aspx was attempted but did not complete within the bounded request window; no login or credential flow was used.
A timeout, map extent miss, login wall, or unusable UI is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, certificate, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission; runtime remains held pending independent serial adapter qualification.
